title: 第一卷 第3章 古卷显圣，丹药升阶
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
夜色渐深，星月悬空。

    清冷月光透过破旧窗棂，洒落在斑驳的石屋之内。

    苏玄尘端坐石床，摒除杂念，翻开了手中泛黄破旧的基础功法——《长春功》。

    这是青玄宗最底层的入门功法，粗浅简陋，只能勉强引气入体，是所有外门弟子的启蒙功法。

    按照功法口诀，苏玄尘凝神静气，尝试引导天地间稀薄的灵气，涌入体内。

    可刚一运转，剧烈的滞涩感瞬间席卷全身。

    嗡——

    体内经脉早已老化萎缩、淤堵堵塞，如同干涸百年的河床，僵硬闭塞。

    外界灵气刚触碰到经脉，便被尽数阻挡，寸步难行。

    根本无法完成引气入体！

    “果然……百岁躯体，弊端极大。”

    苏玄尘眉头微蹙，心中早有预料，却依旧难免凝重。

    极品天灵根，天赋冠绝天下。

    可破败老朽的身躯，却锁死了他所有的天赋。

    空有无上仙资，却无承载之力。

    这便是他此刻最大的困境。

    寻常少年修士，气血鼎盛、经脉通畅，修炼基础功法事半功倍，短短数日便可轻松炼气一层。

    而他，经脉淤堵、气血衰败，哪怕坐拥极品灵根，也被躯体死死桎梏，寸步难进。

    “难道，真的没有半点机会吗？”

    苏玄尘目光落在手边那瓶下品炼气丹上。

    十粒最劣质的入门丹药，药力微弱，只能辅助凡人引气，对正常修士聊胜于无，对他这副破败躯体，更是杯水车薪。

    死马当活马医。

    他取出一粒灰褐色的下品炼气丹，正要送入口中。

    目光扫过怀中的古朴旧书，心念一动。

    八十二年的平凡，会不会只是蛰伏？

    仙缘降临，异象丛生，或许这本古卷，早已悄然蜕变！

    苏玄尘尝试着将这粒下品炼气丹，轻轻放在摊开的书页之间，而后缓缓合上书卷。

    没有惊天动地的异象，没有轰鸣巨响。
content_en:
The night is getting darker and the stars and moon are hanging in the sky.

    The cold moonlight shines through the dilapidated window lattice into the mottled stone house.

    Su Xuanchen sat upright on the stone bed, got rid of distracting thoughts, and opened the yellowed and worn-out basic exercise in his hand - "Changchun Gong".

    This is the lowest introductory skill of Qingxuan Sect. It is crude and crude and can only barely draw Qi into the body. It is the enlightenment skill for all outer disciples.

    According to the formula, Su Xuanchen calmed down and tried to guide the thin spiritual energy between heaven and earth to flow into his body.

    But as soon as it started running, a severe stagnation feeling swept through the whole body instantly.

    Buzz——

    The meridians in the body have long since aged, shrunk, and become clogged. They are like a river bed that has been dry for hundreds of years, stiff and blocked.

    As soon as the external spiritual energy touches the meridians, it is completely blocked, making it difficult to move even an inch.

    It is impossible to complete the introduction of air into the body!

    "Sure enough... a hundred-year-old body has great disadvantages."

    Su Xuanchen frowned slightly. He had already expected it, but he was still solemn.

    The best heavenly spiritual root, the most talented person in the world.

    But his dilapidated and decayed body locked up all his talents.

    There are supreme immortal talents in vain, but there is no carrying power.

    This is his biggest dilemma at the moment.

    An ordinary young monk, with strong Qi and blood and smooth meridians, can practice basic exercises with twice the result with half the effort, and can easily refine Qi to the first level in just a few days.

    As for him, his meridians were blocked and his energy and blood were declining. Even if he had the best spiritual roots, he was still shackled by his body and could not move forward.

    "Is there really no chance?"

    Su Xuanchen's eyes fell on the bottle of low-grade Qi Refining Pill at hand.

    Ten of the lowest quality entry-level elixirs had weak potency and could only assist mortals to draw Qi. It was better than nothing for a normal monk, and it was of no use to his dilapidated body.

    A dead horse is treated as a living horse doctor.

    He took out a gray-brown low-grade Qi Refining Pill and was about to put it into his mouth.

    His eyes glanced at the ancient old book in his arms, and he thought about it.

    Could the eighty-two years of being ordinary be just dormant?

    Immortality has arrived, and visions abound. Perhaps this ancient scroll has already quietly transformed!

    Su Xuanchen tried to place this low-grade Qi Refining Pill gently between the pages of the opened book, and then slowly closed the book.

    There were no earth-shattering visions, no roaring noises.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 3 The ancient scrolls show the saints and the elixirs are upgraded
